facts.fact: Decree n°25/041 of 4 December 2025 creates the Registre Social Unique (RSU), a socio-economic database to harmonise targeting of poor and vulnerable households, centralising beneficiaries' biographic, demographic and biometric data, managed by a steering committee and a technical management unit.

systems.owner: Comité de pilotage and Unité technique de gestion

facts.fact: MINAS says the Registre Social Unique, created by Decree 25/041 of 4 December 2025, has a functional management information system (MIS-DRC) and registered about 465,883 households in 2020-2025, 267,015 of them in 2025.
MINAS says the RSU provides lists of eligible households to the different social programmes, including State ones, under data-sharing protocols.

systems.platform: MIS-DRC web server (cloud) and Android app

facts.fact: The World Bank's STEP project handed the Government the SIG-RDC information system for the Registre Social Unique, which the Minister of Social Affairs said marks a step toward institutionalising the registry by Prime Minister's decree, with servers still to be deployed and data collection on new households to follow.
